subject.title: [Bug]: message send --media applies inconsistent local-media allowlist between WhatsApp and Telegram (same path, same invocation)

question: Should `message send` require one channel-independent local-media authorization result before plugin dispatch, with any channel-specific exception made explicit and documented?
rationale: The report demonstrates a possible permissive authorization divergence, but source-level tracing has not yet established whether the effective roots differ before dispatch or whether one adapter bypasses the shared contract.

options.title: Enforce one shared policy
options.body: Treat the resolved outbound media-access policy as authoritative for every channel and add a two-channel regression test for the reported path.

options.title: Document a channel exception
options.body: Retain WhatsApp-specific broader access only if maintainers explicitly accept it as a supported CLI contract and document its security implications.

recommendation.title: Enforce one shared policy
recommendation.body: Treat the resolved outbound media-access policy as authoritative for every channel and add a two-channel regression test for the reported path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the closest currently open investigation on over-permissive local-media authorization, though ownership remains low-confidence until history is traced.
